verdict.rationale: Navan's developer docs describe an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flow with retrieval endpoints across the expense surface, including receipts (navan-docs-2). A single API also covers card transactions, Connect transactions and manual expenses (navan-docs-4), which delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of scoped tokens or per-permission scopes, explicit confirmation that the API is REST, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
